Track record shows decent hit rate (59/89 = 0.66) but near-coinflip directional accuracy (0.483) on 89 calls, so convictions default low.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Highest cohesion in the eligible trend complex: durability_bar 0.85 (best on the list), breadth 1.00, hurst_tag 'trend', and rank #2 with eligible=true. The absolute-trend gate is validated on this market's history, so a durable, high-breadth trend is the one leg worth respecting. Crowding_z 1.8 is a 'crowded' flag, so this is a size-down caution — not a reason to fade or to buy more aggressively. I lean overweight on the durable breadth and trend-health legs, tempered by crowding.
theses.dissent: Crowding_z 1.8 marks this as the single most crowded theme; attention spikes and crowded leadership frequently mark local tops, and with rank-IC ~0 the momentum rank itself has no forecasting value.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Eligible, hurst_tag 'trend', breadth 0.727, and not crowded (crowding_z 0.83). It sits mid-rank (#4) but has the trend-health and gate eligibility combination that the one validated leg (drawdown control via absolute-trend gate) rewards. Not relying on momentum rank for return; the call is that a non-crowded, eligible, trend-tagged complex holds up better on any shake-out than lower-durability themes.
theses.dissent: Energy is a late-cycle, broad-commodity exposure and macro_narrative is dominated by ai_tech (n=1, unscheduled_share 1.0); the regime backdrop offers no support for an energy allocation, and the rank is only a focus lens.

falsifier.text: XLE breadth falls to 0.45 or lower or hurst flips to mean-revert before the check-by date

theses.subject: Magnificent Seven
theses.thesis: High breadth (0.857) and eligible, but it is the crowded, consensus exposure (QQQ proxy) with mixed hurst and fading top-level momentum (headline val_state 'fading'). Under the detector's discipline, the call is not a fade-or-short but a relative caution: avoid chasing the most consensus AI/tech leader while staying underweight versus the less-crowded AI Infrastructure or Cybersecurity trend legs. This is a sizing-direction caution, not a prediction of decline.
evidence: gate_helps=true but no return edge from rank
theses.dissent: Mag7 has the widest breadth and is the liquid core of the ai_tech macro narrative; underweighting the dominant leadership can underperform precisely because one_narrative is not dominant and the trend has not broken.

falsifier.text: QQQ relative breadth stays above 0.80 and re-accelerates with r10 turning positive before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
